payload.plan: While your reported IPC implementation is pending, Rivet is preparing a reusable Future Branch review checklist against the final four-module plan, before inspecting implementation artifacts.
payload.criteria: Evidence-triggered checks cover intent/outcome durability, strict fail-closed damaged journals, uncertainty and spent allowances despite fresh authority, finite lifetime/idle boundaries, the one existing Coordinator.gate, and named-pipe API/access/remote-rejection semantics.
payload.method: Prepare accept/correct/blocked review branches; treat possible failure modes as hypotheses and record actual results only from pinned source and tests. Separate offline evidence from later native qualification. No speedup or predictive success claim is made.
payload.handoff: Please include immutable source identity and reproducible offline test receipts in the existing implementation handoff. No extra acknowledgment-only reply is needed.
payload.boundary: Review preparation only. No listener, live test, access change, runtime activation or duplicate IPC implementation.
